name: thread
label: Thread - kinetic type and one figure
note: Flat, dark, one idea at a time. English leads, Arabic sits under it, one amber word per line carries the meaning. A single small figure moves through the scenes. Ends on a typographic slam card. Built for short, hard-hitting questions and reminders.
reference: Measured from a 720x1280 reference reel: English line at about 26% of frame height, Arabic at about 35%, handle left-aligned at about 61%, ground line at about 87%. Palette runs crimson (#491722 to #662630) into dusk blue (#252d4a to #6a425f), cream card #efe6d8 with brick red #b54528. The reference puts the source line at about 74% and the brand at about 81%; both are moved up here so the Reels caption and audio strip (everything below y=1440 on a 1920 frame) never cover them.
